title: Design: long and special tier names on the customer card and tier picker
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a long name with spaces that no other record of that kind has, at least 50 characters (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Pricing Plan).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a long name with no spaces, at least 50 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetPricingPlanTier).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier C, with a name with the characters & " ' < > in it (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Tier>).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders and tier B for Part Sales.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  2. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
  3. Open the Part Sales Tier picker.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card's Work Order Tier and Part Sales Tier values show tier A's and tier B's numbers and names inside the card, wrapped if needed, and never cover the next row.
  • The card and the page do not scroll sideways.

Step 2:

  • Edit Customer shows both tier fields with the names inside the field boxes; the dialog stays inside the window.
  • The Save button stays visible.

Step 3:

  • Every row of the list stays inside the picker; no row runs past the list's edge.
  • The current tier is still marked.
  • Tier C's name shows character for character as typed, & " ' < > included.

AUTOMATION: Not available on Build to test Yet - Last checked 11/14/2026
